title: The Button Sewn with the Wrong Thread
youtube_title: The Button Sewn with the Wrong Thread | Bedtime Story for Kids in English
moral: Owning a mistake is how trust grows back.
summary: At a cottage hallway of hooks, rugs, and boots, Una is tangled up with a button sewn on with loud thread that was not the match and almost hides it. Una tells the baker the plain truth, and together they mend what can be mended, with no teasing.
